subject: Apology for the unfinished task mix-up
text: Dear Project Manager, I'm truly sorry for the mix-up regarding the reporting section that is still unfinished. I assumed it was covered by another workstream after our last call, but I take responsibility for not confirming that assumption. I have now returned to the task, completed the first draft, and will send a polished version by tomorrow morning with any remaining notes. If you need an interim update sooner, please let me know immediately.
